content:
1	"""Plain-text customer statements."""
2	
3	
4	def format_cents(cents):
5	    return f"{cents // 100}.{cents % 100:02d}"
6	
7	
8	def render_statement(customer_id, invoices):
9	    lines = [f"Statement for {customer_id}"]
10	    total = 0
11	    for inv in invoices:
12	        lines.append(f"  {inv['id']:<12} {format_cents(inv['total_cents']):>12}")
13	        total += inv["total_cents"]
14	    lines.append(f"  {'TOTAL':<12} {format_cents(total):>12}")
15	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

2	from pathlib import Path
3	
4	GOLDEN = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "golden"
5	
6	
7	def read_golden(name):
8	    data = (GOLDEN / name).read_bytes()
9	    manifest = dict(line.split()[::-1] for line in (GOLDEN / "MANIFEST").read_text().splitlines() if line.strip())
10	    if manifest.get(name) != hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest():
11	        raise AssertionError(f"golden integrity check failed ({name})")
12	    return data.decode()
